visualBrief: Mountain-view-first Rainier photography: Skyline glacier scale and meadow curves on Saturday; the historic Mount Fremont Lookout, human scale, sunset layers, and a familiar headlamp return on Sunday; Pinnacle and the Tatoosh on arrival; Seattle skyline and market energy at the finish. Reflection Lakes is deliberately not a featured subject.
